title: OverTheWire Natas Level 0→1 — recover password from HTML source comment

expected_chain.rationale: GET http://natas0.natas.labs.overthewire.org with basic auth natas0:natas0
grep the response for the HTML comment containing the natas1 password

notes: OverTheWire Natas Level 0 — credentials natas0:natas0 (the level number is the password). The next-level password is hidden in an HTML comment in the page source. ToS-safe; OverTheWire explicitly permits scripted solvers as long as you don't DOS the host.
